senses.gloss: --the wife of the sage उशिज (Asija-वा। प्।), (Utathya वि। प्।) whose younger brother बृहस्पति wanted sexual union with her when she was pregnant eight months; he raped her, and cursed the baby in the womb which obstructed the completion of the act, to be ever in darkness, and hence the child was born blind, दीर्घतमस्; the result of the union was भरद्वाज; ममता, abandoned Bharad- वाज fearing divorce by her husband on account of the in- discret act of बृहस्पति (s.v.) see also दीर्घतमस्. भा. IX. २०. ३७-39; Br. III. ७४. ३६-7; M. ४८. ३२-41; ४९. १७, २६; वा. ९९. ३६-8; Vi. IV. १९ 16.
--flesh offered to Goddess काली. Vi. V. 1. ८६.
